critical_code_review_comments: MentorProfile.jsx is ~505 lines and mixes hero/expertise/booking/reviews/related in one file. Consider splitting into sub-components (BookingWidget, ExperienceTimeline, ReviewsGrid) if it grows further — currently acceptable.

Booking success toast hardcodes 'We'll email you a Google Meet link.' but no actual booking/Meet integration exists yet — copy is misleading to end users. Consider softening to 'We'll confirm your slot by email' until real booking API is built.
getMentorById returns undefined for bad IDs which is handled well, but consider a 404 HTTP-style semantic (helmet noindex meta) later for SEO.
The whole booking submit reuses /api/waitlist — acknowledged as MOCKED per request. When the real booking API is built, replace the axios.post URL and payload shape.
seed_data_creation: None. Test triggered one real POST /api/waitlist with email 'booking-request+m1@vicharo.in' role 'mentee' source 'mentor-m1-Mon-8:30 PM' — backend accepted (200).
